documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key markets, improved realizations, and stable raw material prices. The management noted that their 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha is progressing on schedule for commissioning in the coming months, while existing facilities operate near full capacity. The company remains optimistic about the medium to long-term outlook supported by global demand, sustainability initiatives, and favorable trade developments. Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth, improved profitability, and high capacity utilization exceeding 96%. The company announced a greenfield capacity expansion of 1.50 lakh spindles in Odisha with an outlay of approximately INR 1000 Crores, alongside proposed mergers for forward integration into fabrics and garments.

guidance.claim: The company expects a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores from the new Odisha capacity in the remaining period of the current financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores coming off the capacity in the time left in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue of INR1,200 crores to INR1,300 crores from the new capacity in the next financial year.
guidance.quote: And we expect a revenue of around INR1,200 to INR1,300 crores in next financial year and about INR150 to INR200 crores in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Margins in the new Odisha unit are expected to be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% higher than the operational margins achieved otherwise.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: The company expects its top line to be around INR3,000 crores for the current year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue to go up to more than INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Long-term sustainable margins are expected to stay around 15% after the Odisha plant.
guidance.quote: Frankly, if you ask me, 28%, there was a lot of issues of supply chain disruptions and there were many duplication of orders. So that year was an aberration. But otherwise, we expect the long-term margins to stay after our Odisha plant around 15%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets remained healthy due to improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from our export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company holds visibility for its order book until March 10, and demand continues to be strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good. The demand is the same or even better than what it was. So the demand outlook continues to be strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports accounted for about 52% of total revenue in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: So it is about 52% of our total revenue the last quarter has been through exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, with supportive domestic demand aided by the festive season.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand for yarn export into India has come from China.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule with building construction almost complete and machinery arriving.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete. The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production for the Odisha greenfield project is intended to start within the next 30 to 40 days.
capex_expansion.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is expected to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned, with the first phase of production expected to commence in the third quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Total announced capex for the Odisha project is about INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The successful commissioning of the solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Power in Odisha will be available at INR4 per unit for 10 years compared to around INR6 in Punjab.
margins_costs.quote: We are going to get power at INR4 for 10 years in Odisha.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation run rate for the next quarter is expected to be around INR17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost savings from the solar project are quantified at around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant features embedded incentives that are expected to yield margins 300 to 400 basis points or more higher than old plants.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: The overall spread for the quarter was INR133 compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing facilities operated at 99% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The Odisha project includes a 30% capital subsidy to be paid in 5 equal installments, translating to about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back over 5 years on a INR1,000 crores investment.
capital_allocation.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: A Special Purpose Vehicle commissioned a Solar Power Plant with a capacity of 40.3 MW for a period of 25 years.
capital_allocation.quote: The SPV has commissioned the Solar Power Plant with capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to Company`s Bathinda and Ludhiana Unit for period of 25 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The proposed business merger will be predominantly executed via preferential shares with a small cash outflow of less than INR25 crores to INR30 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So the merger will be predominantly preferential shares. So there will be a small outflow of cash. I think it will be less than maybe around INR25 crores, INR30 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The SPV commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to finish the entire Odisha project within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach about 90% capacity utilization for the whole Odisha plant by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 96% to 97% utilization of the new capacity by the start of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
